title: CanonicalEvidence
description: Canonical evidence records, with one definition per record family. Record ids are assigned once and persisted. A source names one file record; repository.json supplies the repository and commit. Cites name persisted evidence ids. Legacy scan contracts and producers remain separate until the replacement is proven.

source.description: A persisted source id, or an explicit historical code reference retained from an authored GraphQL document.

document.description: The complete authored GraphQL text retained during migration; selections are parsed deterministically.
